messages:
deploybot: Reminder: Tonight's change window 22:45-00:45 UTC. We're gating feature flag `heartbeat_mode` with a slowstart plan: internal-only -> 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%. Holdpoints 4m for first two steps, then 6m thereafter. Pin: image@sha256:deafbeef. Rollback criteria: 5xx rate > 0.4% OR latency p95 delta > 120ms across two consecutive holds.
jen: Thanks. I'll add the rollout paragraph to release notes and note the KV cache freeze. Also pinging @pm-lead for product sign-off on internal slice.
pm-lead: Signed off on internal slice. Please ensure beta cohort isn't included in the first step.
devin: infra ready. Autoscaler warmup set to 6m. I deployed the pin to the manifests and set a temporary routing rule for internal-only cohort using cookie:internal=true.
maria: Ops suggestion: disable KV prefetch for first 12m to avoid thundering herd. Also enable debug logging sampling for new path at 0.1% for better traces.
samir: Dashboards to watch: /dash/heartbeat/errors, /dash/heartbeat/latency, traces: /traces/heartbeat. I'll create a small synthetic probe hitting the route at 120s intervals.
qa-bot: Quick preflight summary: unit tests green, load smoke within thresholds, schema checks passed. Artifact verified: artifact://service/v3.7.2@sha256:deafbeef.
jen: Ops script to toggle percent (ops token required):
```
POST /flags/toggle HTTP/1.1
Host: flags.redwood.internal
Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{"flag":"heartbeat_mode","percent":3,"note":"step-2-canary"}
```

samir: For fast rollback: set percent to 0 and revert routing weight to previous stable sha. If traffic doesn't fall within 30s, trigger `kubectl rollout undo` and call pager. Ops-bot will escalate if SLO breach persists >5m.
ops-bot: Maintenance window locked 22:45-00:45 UTC. Alerts: SLO breach -> #oncall -> page primary.
jen: Small coordination note: We'll tag the public changelog as "improves routing resiliency; gradual rollout" but keep experimental details internal. Legal reviewed data-export — no changes.
maria: Confirmed model-serving pinned to v1.14 as per manifest. No db migration in this change.
devin: I'll be standing by to flip flags and promote images if canary healthy.
jen: I'll be on-call for the window. Posting runbook link: https://intranet/runbooks/heartbeat-rollout. Let's keep chatter minimal during the window. :coffee:
